senses.nuances: 本项仅说明可核实的专名用法，不是已获DBP确认的词义。上述马来语释义为编辑说明，并非DBP原文。不同来源使用Ultralink或UltraLink等写法，不能据此将它们视为同一事物，也不能直接译为“超链接”。以下搭配为教学示例，未核实为高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Ultralink and UltraLink appear in modern naming rather than one verified Malay word history. Gentec uses Ultralink for smart-home products, while a 2024 research paper names a multilingual training dataset UltraLink. These separate uses show why context matters. Their existence does not establish a shared origin, a Malay borrowing date, an official pronunciation, or a dictionary meaning for the lowercase form supplied here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先把ultralink记成“需要看上下文辨认的名称”。尚无可靠的规范马来语读音，暂不编造谐音口诀，也不将它直接记作“超链接”。
